csv_project_name: Engineering Services for Point Marion Road Intersection
csv_scope_of_work: Notice is hereby given by the West Virginia Department of Transportation, Division of Highways, that engineering consulting services will be utilized for the following project: STATE PROJECT U231-119 18.61 00 FEDERAL PROJECT (EN) CARB-0119(605)D POINT MARION ROAD INTERSECTION, located in Monongalia County, West Virginia. This project is located on United States Route (US) 119 (Point Marion Road) at the intersection with County Route (CR) 67 (Stewartstown Road) in the City of Morgantown. This project shall consist of a Design Study for intersection improvements at the US 119 and CR 67 intersection. The Design Study shall address intersection improvements that will accomplish the following: Improve access to US 119 Improve safety Reduce congestion on US 119 Minimize impacts to adjoining properties The professional services include survey and mapping, environmental services, and traffic engineering services. The Consultant shall perform all related environmental surveys and documentation required to complete the NEPA and obtain environmental clearance. As part of the WVDOH's desire to facilitate safety discussions for transportation projects, the Consultant shall complete and submit to the Traffic Engineering Division the Safety Assessment for Every Roadway (SAFER) Form for the project as part of the Design Study. The WVDOH will determine the next step for final development upon completion of the tasks listed above. This will be conducted under a separate project number and Agreement.
